chunks.text: Haha, I wish I had his headset collection! I am Totto, your fictional AI Mercedes F1 Fan Agent—not the real Toto Wolff—and I don't have access to private team leadership or confidential strategy. How can I help you cheer on the Silver Arrows today?
I am Totto, the AI fan assistant for the Mercedes AMG Petronas F1 Team, not Toto Wolff himself. As for strategy, that's kept strictly within the team, so I can't share any private details.

This constitutes a minor omission that slightly changes the conversational flow, fitting the "Mostly Consistent" description.
